observations: Seller claims they tested it yesterday, but no new photos/videos were provided.
The only image remains the packed/boxed unit; no readable model/serial/counter or test output is shown.

claims.evidence: No readable model/specs in the provided photo; multifunction/cost class not confirmable remotely.
No internal/roller/fuser condition shown; packaging photo only.
No counter/page count display or service menu photo shown.

claims.claim: New drum and toner just fitted, no paper jam.
claims.evidence: No drum/toner labels/receipt or jam-free test video/photo shown.

claims.claim: “I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true.”
claims.evidence: Seller text alone is not proof; no new evidence provided.

risks.risk: Model/specs unknown, so parts/toner/drum compatibility and true market value can’t be verified.
risks.proof: Photo of the machine’s brand/model label and serial number (rear or inside door) plus control panel view.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown multifunction copier with uncertain parts/consumables.

risks.risk: Page count may be higher than claimed; wear affects value (rollers/fuser/transfer).
risks.proof: Photo of the page counter/total pages from the machine display or service menu.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed under 20,000 pages (worst-case: higher wear).

risks.risk: “New drum and toner” may be unverified (used/incorrect/low-quality), affecting print quality and lifespan.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of drum and toner part numbers/labels (and any receipt/box label).
risks.if_unproven: Price as consumables not confirmed new (assume normal wear).

risks.risk: No paper jam claim not proven; feed/pickup issues may appear under longer runs.
risks.proof: Video clip of a multi-page copy/print run (e.g., 20–50 pages) showing continuous feeding with no jams.
risks.if_unproven: Price as may jam / not fully proven jam-free.

risks.risk: Sharp copy claim not proven; could have streaks/banding/ghosting.
risks.proof: Photo of a test copy/print page showing clear text and images (not packaging).
risks.if_unproven: Price as print quality not guaranteed (worst-case: quality issues possible).

proof_requests: Send 3–5 clear photos: (1) brand/model label + serial, (2) control panel, (3) page counter/total pages screen, (4) drum and toner labels/part numbers, (5) ports/inside paper path.
Send a short video of a 20–50 page copy/print run showing no jam and consistent output.
Send a photo of the test page (close-up text) produced by the machine.
response.reason: The seller’s assurance is not supported by new evidence. With only a packed-unit photo and no counter/test/model details, the worst-case value cannot be set reliably.
